cross_paths.evidence: drain-side current of the same network
cross_paths.name: drain_side_flux_sum

contacts.body: Si bottom y = 1.2 um: psi = psi_b0; zero normal electron flux (no electron contact equation)
contacts.drain: ohmic, far edge x = L + l_w, 0 <= y <= h_w: psi = V_T asinh(N_net/(2 n_i)) + s_couple * V_D; phi_n = V_D
contacts.faces_below_well: far edges for y > h_w: homogeneous Neumann for psi and zero normal electron flux
contacts.gate: oxide top y = -t_ox: psi = V_G + psi_b0
contacts.oxide_sides: homogeneous Neumann, except the two Si/SiO2 triple points at the source/drain faces, whose potential is tied to the adjacent silicon Dirichlet value
contacts.source: ohmic, far edge x = -l_w, 0 <= y <= h_w: psi = V_T asinh(N_net/(2 n_i)) (charge-neutral value); phi_n = 0

doping.profile: abrupt: N_D(x, y) = 1e20 for (x < 0 or x > L) and y <= h_w, else 0
doping.vertical: box: donors only for 0 <= y <= h_w (realized mesh line)

geometry.coordinates: x along the channel (source side first), y depth into Si (y = 0 at Si/SiO2 interface, oxide at -t_ox <= y <= 0)

physics.gate_convention: gate contact psi_gate = V_G + psi_b0 (V_FB = 0; no work-function difference, no oxide charge)
physics.holes: not solved; equilibrium p = n_i exp(-psi/V_T) everywhere (hole quasi-Fermi level 0 V)
physics.mobility: constant mu_n (field-independent); zero-bias network edge conductance c_e = q mu_n EdgeCouple EIL n0 B(Delta)
physics.oxide: SiO2, no fixed or trapped charge, no carriers
physics.psi_reference: intrinsic Fermi level (psi = 0 at n = p = n_i)
physics.units: 2-D simulation; currents in A/cm and conductances in S/cm per unit device width

mesh.generator: phase3/direction_reset/well_depth_probe.py (tensor-product node lines, each rectangle split into two triangles; refinement factor sqrt(2) per level)

notes: Zero-bias linear-response conductance: at equilibrium grad(phi_n) = 0, so the O(V_D) current is that of the medium sigma0 = q mu_n n0(x, y) and does not depend on the electrostatic response (phase3/reports/C6_Theory_ZeroBias_EndCorrection_2026-10-31.md, P4). Any drift-diffusion code can therefore be scored on G0 = lim I_D/V_D (V_D -> 0).
Bottom boundary fixed at y = 1.2 um; at h_w = 1 um the margin is 0.2 um (< W_dep), so depth and bottom-boundary effects are not separated.

G0_S_per_cm.path: source-side terminal current of the zero-bias network (phi_n = 0 source, 1 drain); cancellation-free side, equal to the edge-energy / characteristic-potential form

G_GCA_S_per_cm.definition: long-channel (1-column) sheet conductance / L used as the dL reference

bracket.scope: Rayleigh bounds of THIS discrete network on THIS mesh; valid only for same-mesh submissions, not a bound on the continuum value

sources.role: well-depth probe state (deck R, abrupt wells)

uncertainty.basis: single mesh; bottom-boundary margin confounds the depth trend (Direction_Reset_Correction_and_Next_Investment_2026-11-01.md)
